evidence.gambling: Slot machines, fortune tellers, dice rooms and arcade rooms.
evidence.multiple_endings: 20+ endings gated by alternate final bosses (Mom's Heart, Satan, Lamb, Delirium, Mother, Beast).
evidence.optional_challenges: Challenge rooms, Boss Rush, Hush timers and 45 numbered Challenges.

name: The Swords of Ditto: Mormo's Curse

evidence.time_pressure: Each hero has a limited number of in-game days before facing Mormo.
evidence.narrative_across_runs: On death, a new Sword of Ditto is chosen 100 years later and the world changes.
evidence.passive_relics: Stickers equipped on the hero grant passive buffs; Toys act as active items.

evidence.build_archetypes: Character classes and traits push distinct builds (summoner, spell, melee, ranged).
evidence.bullet_hell: Rooms fill with dense projectile patterns to dodge.
evidence.early_access_dev: Long-running Early Access with frequent content updates.

evidence.deckbuilding: Each hero's deck is derived from the equipment they carry.
evidence.grid_tactics: Battles on a hex grid with facing and positioning.
evidence.energy_mana: Willpower earned by discarding cards fuels plays.
evidence.random_events: Storybook encounters across an explorable overworld.

evidence.in_run_currency: Gold collected in a run funds permanent upgrades, but each death forfeits a portion of it.
evidence.permanent_stat_upgrades: Gold buys permanent hub upgrades that every successive peasant inherits.
evidence.cursed_items: Curses from cursed relics and altar bargains impose lasting run penalties.
evidence.narrative_across_runs: Rescued NPCs return to the hub and story unfolds across successive peasants.

evidence.procgen_levels: Cyclic dungeon generation builds Zelda-like lock-and-key loops with puzzles, not just room grids.
evidence.environmental_hazards: Traps, pits and spreading fire are used against the player and enemies.

evidence.cursed_items: Unidentified gear may be cursed and cannot be unequipped until uncursed.
evidence.healing_scarcity: Healing is rare; HP is a run-long resource in the brutal side-scrolling crawl.
evidence.level_up_choices: Level-ups give a stat point and a choice of class-specific perk.

evidence.deckbuilding: Fixed-size 20-card deck; new cards are swapped in rather than added.
evidence.item_upgrading: Void Stones are socketed into cards for added effects.
evidence.rng_mitigation: Pre-fight purge/swap options and fixed deck size reduce draw variance.

evidence.enemy_intents: Every unit shows a counter that ticks down each turn; it acts at zero.
evidence.hub_building: Snowdwell town is rebuilt across runs, unlocking new cards, charms and pets.
evidence.modular_difficulty: Storm Bells toggle individual hardship modifiers.
evidence.item_upgrading: Charms permanently modify a card for the run.

evidence.synergies: Alterattack - finishing a combo with one weapon triggers the other equipped weapon's special.
evidence.unlock_items: Blueprints and weapons are unlocked in the Ark hub for future runs.

evidence.talent_slots: Four arcana slots (basic, dash, standard, signature) plus one in-run swap slot.
evidence.elemental_interactions: Eight elements with interactions (water + lightning, ice + earth).
evidence.loadout_start: Chaos Gems buy arcana, relics and robes at the hub to set a pre-run loadout.
evidence.cursed_items: Cursed relics give strong buffs with drawbacks.

evidence.time_pressure: Each expedition has a limited time before Chaos overruns the world.
evidence.crafting: Gathered materials are crafted at the Tower into new bullet types and gear.
evidence.elemental_interactions: Ammo types (fire, ice, lightning) combine with environmental effects.

evidence.poker_hands: Score by spelling words from drawn letter tiles, Balatro-style blinds.
evidence.multiplicative_scaling: Joker-like modifiers stack chips and multipliers on words.
